completed_debug_profile_cleanup.reason: qualification resource preflight requires 20 GiB free; release CLI and frozen qualification binaries retained

methodology.active_push_rate: Timed successful replay commits divided by summed timed successful and failed push wall time. Untimed ordinal 850 is excluded from both numerator and denominator; pipeline rate separately includes all commits. Operator recovery, inventory, clone and fsck pauses are excluded.
methodology.clone_throughput: Installed Git pack bytes divided by complete --no-checkout clone command wall time; generated response-cache publication included; fsck timed separately.
methodology.comparison: Single shared macOS host; local checks and resource pressure overlapped parts of the earlier replay. Not valid for controlled performance comparison.
methodology.latency: Complete successful push command wall time; failed attempt is retained separately. Ordinal 850 lost supervisor wall-time/RSS after runner interruption; its 1304 ms CLI pipeline duration is retained. CLI pipeline duration is available consistently for all commits and excludes process startup/teardown.
methodology.memory: Sampled aggregate process-tree RSS every 50 ms; not a hard allocation bound.
methodology.provenance: Git's complete run and Kubernetes seed/commits 1-573 use the prior candidate. Kubernetes resumption 574-1000 and yt-dlp use the final candidate. Final source checks all three existing repositories.
methodology.push_throughput: New immutable capsule bytes divided by complete command wall time; failed-attempt bytes counted separately and included in aggregate active-attempt throughput. Excludes retry/readback wire traffic.
methodology.remaining_causal_gap: The original provider error behind failed Kubernetes CAS 574 was discarded by the CLI outcome; its transport cause is unproven. Fault injection independently proves and verifies the unchanged-head recovery gap.

resource_budget.reason: Measured seed pack ~1.2 GiB; source and authoring output reused; complete integrity checks retained. Configured capacity run, not the default 20 GiB profile.
Standard preflight restored after volume capacity increased above 300 GiB.

pushes.measurement_note: Durable commit and CLI success verified; supervisor wall time and RSS unavailable after runner interruption.

runner_interruption.cause: Runner process disappeared without a terminal report; cause unproven. CLI reported successful publication, awaiting durable-state reconciliation.

verification_harness_repairs.explanation: git_value rejects empty output; clean git status legitimately returns empty. Corrected consumer reads command stdout directly and retains the empty-status assertion. Existing independently verified clone reused.

second_error.reason: Extra remote Crab fsck was invoked in a plain Git remote-helper clone without Crab project configuration; rerun from the existing configured publication client. Native checkout cleanliness passed.
